decisions_log.decision: Used CSS scroll-behavior: smooth on :root rather than a JS onClick handler to satisfy the smooth-scroll requirement.
decisions_log.rationale: The sketch explicitly prefers the lowest-impact path (standard anchor + CSS). Adding scroll-behavior to globals.css achieves smooth scroll without any client-side JS, keeping the page component a pure Server Component.

decisions_log.decision: Link wrapped in a <div className="text-right mt-8"> rather than using flex/self-end directly on the anchor.
decisions_log.rationale: The parent <main> uses flex-col. text-right on a block wrapper is the simplest idiomatic Tailwind approach to right-align inline content without restructuring the flex container. mt-8 gives visual separation from the list.

decisions_log.decision: The inline link is distinct from the existing components/BackToTop.tsx scroll-triggered button — both coexist without conflict.
decisions_log.rationale: components/BackToTop.tsx is a floating scroll-triggered button rendered in the Footer. The new anchor is a static inline element in the changelog page flow. They serve different UX patterns on different pages.

files_changed.summary: Added id="changelog-heading" to the <h1>; added right-aligned <a href="#changelog-heading"> link with text 'Back to top' and muted zinc-500/dark:zinc-400 styling immediately after <ChangelogList />.
Added scroll-behavior: smooth to :root so anchor navigation triggers smooth scrolling without a JS click handler.

Extended existing ChangelogPage test file with a new describe block covering AC1 (link present, right-aligned, muted styling) and AC2 (h1 has correct id, link href targets heading, link follows heading in DOM order).
